lines: Mere humnafas, mere humnawa, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: My closest companion, do not betray me in the name of friendship.

lines: Main hoon dard-e-ishq se jaan-ba-lab, mujhe zindagi ki dua na de
couplets.en: Love has brought me to my last breath, so do not pray that I live.

lines: Mere daagh-e-dil se hai roshni, isi roshni se hai zindagi
couplets.en: The wound in my heart gives light, and by that light I live.

lines: Mujhe dar hai ai mere charagar, ye charagh tu hi bujha na de
couplets.en: I fear that you, my healer, might be the one to put out this lamp.

lines: Mujhe chhor de mere haal par, tera kya bharosa hai charagar
couplets.en: Leave me as I am, my healer, for how can I trust you?

lines: Ye teri nawazish-e-mukhtasar, mera dard aur barha na de
couplets.en: May this brief kindness of yours spare me any further pain.

lines: Mere humnafas, mere humnawa, mujhe dost ban ke dagha na de
couplets.en: My closest companion, do not betray me in the name of friendship.

lines: Mera azm itna buland hai ke paraye sholon ka dar nahin
couplets.en: My resolve is strong enough to face the flames of strangers.

lines: Mujhe khauf aatish-e-gul se hai, ye kahin chaman ko jala na de
couplets.en: I fear the flame in the rose might burn the garden down.
My closest companion, my kindred voice.

lines: Woh uthe hain le ke khum-o-subu, are o Shakeel, kahan hai tu
couplets.en: They have risen with the wine jar and pitcher, and where are you, Shakeel?

lines: Tera jaam lene ko bazm mein koi aur haath barha na de
couplets.en: May no other hand in the gathering reach for your cup.
